faq.subtitle: Have questions? We've got answers. If you can't find what you're looking for, feel free to contact us.

download.q: How do I download the Ustaz app?
download.a: You can download the Ustaz app from the Google Play Store. Simply search for 'Ustaz' and click Install. The app is free to download and use.

free.q: Is the Ustaz app free to use?
free.a: Yes, the Ustaz app is completely free to download and use. You only pay for the services you book through the app. There are no hidden fees or subscriptions.

cities.q: Which cities does Ustaz operate in?
cities.a: Currently, Ustaz operates in Karachi with plans to expand to other cities across Pakistan including Lahore, Islamabad, and Peshawar soon.

provider.q: How do I become a service provider?
provider.a: Download the Ustaz app and tap on 'Become a Provider'. Fill out the registration form with your details and service category. Our team will verify your information and get you onboarded.

payment.a: We accept payments via digital wallets like JazzCash and EasyPaisa, direct bank transfer, and hand-to-hand cash payment after service completion.

support.q: How can I contact customer support?
support.a: You can reach our customer support team 24/7 through the app, WhatsApp at +92 305 1126649, or email at support@ustaz.pk. We're always here to help!
